prompt: I need to deploy a 3-node NATS JetStream cluster on Kubernetes. We're running production workloads and need file storage that survives pod restarts. Give me the Helm values or manifests and explain the sizing.

assertions.text: Declares 3 replicas (StatefulSet or Helm cluster size 3)
JetStream file storage backed by a PersistentVolumeClaim
Pins a specific NATS image tag (not 'latest')
Includes pod anti-affinity to spread across nodes
